C:P1.2.text: We are dedicated to improving the lives of people with lymphedema, lipedema and chronic venous insufficiency through the use of our at-home treatments.

C:P1.3.text: When we lift lymphedema and respiratory care, we change what’s possible for millions of patients. At Tactile Medical, we are committed to partnering with others to deliver on our promise of lifting care everywhere. Because when care rises, lives rise with it.

C:P1.4.text: Learn About Lymphedema & How Common It Is

C:P1.5.text: Lymphedema is a chronic swelling condition that affects millions of people, yet it’s often overlooked or mistaken for everyday swelling. Caused by a buildup of lymph fluid in the body, it can lead to heaviness, tightness, discomfort, and reduced mobility. While many associate lymphedema with cancer treatment, it can also develop after surgery, injury, or for reasons unrelated to cancer. Because the signs aren’t always obvious, many people may be living with symptoms without realizing it.

C:P1.12.text: Chronic respiratory conditions and neuromuscular disorders can make it harder for the lungs to clear mucus. Changes in the airways—such as swelling or inflammation—can cause mucus to stick, and for people with neuromuscular disorders, weak cough muscles may prevent mucus from being cleared at all. When mucus can’t move, it can build up over time, leading to chronic cough, infection, and flare‑ups.
